name: Mixed vegetable sabzi (semi-dry Indian mixed vegetables)

source.name: Cook With Manali (cookwithmanali.com)
source.license: Ingredient amounts as listed in the cited recipe, converted to grams; nutrients composed from USDA FoodData Central (CC0)

notes: Serves 3. A semi-dry sabzi (vegetables in a thick onion-tomato masala), not a dry stir-fry: no dry-style mix veg with clear quantities was found on the preferred sites. Weights: 2 tbsp oil = 27 g, 1 cup cauliflower florets = 100 g, 1/2 cup cut beans = 55 g, 1/2 cup diced carrot = 64 g, 1 medium onion = 110 g, 1 inch ginger = 6 g, 3.5 large garlic cloves = 17.5 g, 1.5 green chillies = 7.5 g, tomato 140 g (as listed), 1.5 tbsp tomato paste = 24 g, 1/2 cup frozen peas = 72 g, 2 cloves = 0.2 g, 2 tsp coriander seeds = 3.6 g, 1/2 tbsp butter = 7 g. Kasuri methi as fenugreek seed, garam masala as curry powder; optional paneer garnish left out. Water 2 tbsp + 1/2 cup = 150 g; assumed most of it and ~10% of vegetable weight cooks off. A katori or bowl is taken as 1 cup, as everywhere in the catalog.

ingredients.food: Tomato, paste, canned, without salt added
Peas, green, frozen, unprepared (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)
